TANMAI SRIVASTAVA Senior Production Support Engineer | US Healthcare Payer Domain | Incident, Problem & Change Management | 9+ Years Experience Pune, Maharashtra, India | +91-9036448206 | tanmaisrivastava1106@outlook.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Production Support Engineer with 9+ years delivering L2/L3 production support, major incident management and RCA-driven issue resolution across Healthcare, Cyber Security, FinTech and Enterprise Product organizations — including hands-on experience supporting HealthEdge Technologies' US Healthcare Payer platform. Owns production stability and incident response end-to-end — directing P1/P2 bridge calls, performing SQL-based debugging and data analysis, and coordinating Development, QA, Infrastructure and Business teams through permanent fixes. Works directly with US-based clients and stakeholders during critical incidents and reports directly to the Technical Director on vulnerability remediation and risk posture. Builds Shell/Bash automation to improve support efficiency and reduce time-to-resolution, and translates operational outcomes into executive-ready reporting.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Healthcare Payer Domain: Production support for HealthEdge Technologies' US Healthcare Payer platform, Enterprise Healthcare Applications

L2/L3 Production Support & Incident Management: Major Incident Management, P1/P2 Incident Leadership, Bridge Call Leadership, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Problem Management, Change Management

SQL & Data Analysis: SQL query debugging, data analysis for production issue resolution ● Automation & Scripting: Shell / Bash Scripting, Jenkins CI/CD, Git, Bitbucket, Ansible (exposure) ● Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch), Kubernetes, Linux / Windows Administration, Docker

Client & Stakeholder Management: Client-facing communication, cross-functional leadership, executive reporting, technical documentation

Governance & Risk: Vulnerability Management, Risk Reporting, SLA / SLO / SLI, Jira, Confluence, ITIL ● Monitoring (Supporting Skill): Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, PagerDuty

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Production Support Engineer | HealthEdge Technologies

Feb 2025 – June 2026

Provide L2/L3 production support for HealthEdge's US Healthcare Payer platform, supporting enterprise applications and driving resolution of complex production issues affecting business and client operations

Write and troubleshoot SQL queries against payer platform databases to diagnose data inconsistencies and drive root-cause identification during production incidents

Lead incident, problem and change management activities across P1/P2 production issues — directing bridge calls, performing RCA, and implementing permanent fixes in coordination with Development, QA, Infrastructure and Business teams

Support production infrastructure underpinning Claims, Benefits, Enrollment and Provider Management modules, ensuring platform stability and uptime at the infrastructure layer

Lead the Security Vulnerability Remediation Program, directing Dev, Infra and Security teams to resolve vulnerabilities within SLA; report directly to the Technical Director on program status and risk posture

Manage the vulnerability Jira project end-to-end — assigning, tracking and escalating tasks across engineering teams; deliver monthly vulnerability reports with trend analysis and risk highlights to senior leadership

Author Shell/Bash scripts and apply Claude AI for log analysis to automate troubleshooting workflows and reduce MTTR

Manage production troubleshooting for Kubernetes-based applications, resolving deployment issues, pod failures and configuration errors

Establish alert thresholds and escalation runbooks using Prometheus/Grafana monitoring; lead server upgrades and post-upgrade validation to sustain stability across critical healthcare infrastructure

DevOps Engineer | Qualys Security Techservices Pvt. Ltd.

Jan 2023 – Feb 2025

Configured and owned Prometheus, Grafana and PagerDuty for daily production troubleshooting; authored alert rules and oncall escalation policies for production workloads

Built and maintained Splunk dashboards to troubleshoot application performance issues and support operational reporting

Executed CI/CD pipelines via Jenkins for deployments across DEV, QA and Production environments ● Managed AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and administered 125+ Bitbucket repositories ● Authored shell scripts to automate troubleshooting workflows; led 24x7 on-call production support, coordinating team response during active incidents

Administered Linux/CentOS environments and supported Kubernetes operations

Advisory Support Engineer | Pitney Bowes

Oct 2021 – Jan 2023

Monitored production applications using AWS CloudWatch and Splunk daily; partnered with Product Owners to configure alerting per client requirements

Directed outage management end-to-end — detection, stakeholder notification, incident bridge calls, progress tracking and post-incident RCA

Managed Jira dashboards for task assignment and led team progress tracking during production troubleshooting; maintained team knowledge base

Led 24x7 production support for internal products including SendPro Online and Lockers, ensuring SLA compliance

NOC Engineer | Qualys Security Techservices Pvt. Ltd.

Jul 2018 – Oct 2021

Owned major incident management, including outage handling, RCA and long-term resolution planning across global IT operations

Leveraged PagerDuty, Grafana, Kafka monitoring and Splunk daily for real-time production troubleshooting ● Delivered KPIs, trend reports and SOPs; drove ITSM process maturity across Global IT Operations ● Served as shift lead in manager's absence, directing the team through production troubleshooting; managed Problem Management workflows with cross-team follow-up

ATS Engineer, Incident Management | Fidelity National Financial India

Mar 2016 – Jun 2018

Delivered L1/L2 production troubleshooting for internal applications; led bridge calls, authored RCAs and maintained SOPs aligned to ITIL guidelines

Administered applications across Linux, Windows and AWS; resolved escalations for insurance and banking clients

TECHNICAL SKILLS

SQL | L2/L3 Production Support | Incident, Problem & Change Management | RCA | Shell / Bash Scripting | AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) | Kubernetes | Docker | Linux / Windows | Jenkins | Git | Bitbucket | Ansible (exposure) | Jira | Confluence | ITIL | SLA / SLO / SLI | Prometheus | Grafana | Splunk | PagerDuty

CERTIFICATIONS

● Certified Scrum Master

IT Infrastructure, System and Security — CDAC
